info.name: Enterprise CRM API
info.description:
Production-ready Enterprise CRM API Collection.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

Authentication: Bearer Token (JWT)

Set the `accessToken` variable after login — all protected routes use it automatically via the Collection-level Authorization.

Phases covered:
- Phase 2: Authentication
- Phase 3: Roles & Permissions
- Phase 4: User Management

response.name: 422 – Validation Error
200 OK – Reset Email Sent (or silently ignored)
200 OK – Password Reset
400 – Invalid/Expired Token
200 OK – Password Changed
200 OK – Roles List
200 OK – Role with Permissions
201 Created
400 – Cannot Delete Role With Users
200 OK – Users List
